summary: Same-day re-validation after fixing three defects found by the CI-era eval harness: (1) collision telemetry was read after auto-reset so collisionRate was structurally 0.0; (2) PPO trained clamped actions with their own log-probs — a log-prob cliff that NaN'd the network around iteration 350 on the 8D layout; (3) progress-only reward admitted an orbit limit cycle (nominal 0% with min-distance 0.04 m short of the goal). All fixed in-engine; gates now judged on Wilson CI bounds with 50 episodes per envelope. Metrics below are the post-fix honest numbers, including runs that FAIL the gate.

defectsFoundAndFixed.rootCause: rollout read _collision_flags after GoalNavEnv.step auto-reset had cleared it; finalDistance read the resampled pose
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: terminal state captured before reset (self._episode_final); rollout_episode uses it

defectsFoundAndFixed.rootCause: PPO stored clamp(a,-1,1) with log-prob of the clamped point; when the Gaussian mean drifted outside [-1,1], log_prob(+-1) went to ~-30 per dim, the importance ratio overflowed to 1e28, and gradients poisoned the weights
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: train on the unclamped sampled action with its matching log-prob (env saturates at execution) + log-space ratio clamp at +-20; applied to both engine paths

defectsFoundAndFixed.rootCause: progress reward is flat on a goal orbit (per-step distance deltas cancel around the circle) — the policy converged to a limit cycle, entering the goal radius only by luck under the hard envelope's actuator lag
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: dwell reward (0.2 per step within 1.5x goal radius) + goalDistance 0.15; hardware cost is the same distance check

defectsFoundAndFixed.defect: collision 12% point estimate failed the CI-upper gate
defectsFoundAndFixed.rootCause: one-shot collision penalty teaches avoidance only through the value function — weak gradient before contact
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: obstacleProximity penalty (-0.3, ramping within 0.15 m of obstacle surface); computable on hardware against operator-mapped obstacles

varianceLesson: Single-run differences between reward configs swung nominal success by +-30 points NON-monotonically in the perturbed weight (S100: 90% -> 68% -> 10% as the proximity penalty went none -> -0.3 -> -0.1). With one training run per config and chaotic training dynamics, that pattern is noise-dominated, not a reward-shaping signal. Conclusions drawn from it would be unfalsifiable storytelling. What WAS established causally (trajectory-level diagnosis, not A/B comparison): the orbit limit cycle and its dwell fix. The proximity term was reverted; the honest lever for the collision-CI gate is more episodes per envelope (tighter CI) and/or genuinely better avoidance learning, which needs multi-seed evaluation to even measure.

gate.note: success-side PASSES the CI gate; only the collision CI upper bound fails

conclusion: Engine correctness work is done and verified: no NaN (root cause fixed), honest collision telemetry, Wilson CI gating with cross-check, cross-process determinism. The S100 42D path clears the success-side CI gate (0.786 >= 0.70 at 50 episodes). What the gate still honestly refuses: collision CI upper bound 0.238 > 0.15 — point estimate 0.12 is under the bar but 50 episodes cannot certify it. The next real lever is avoidance learning measured across multiple seeds, or more episodes per envelope (100 -> CI width ~2x tighter). Chasing single-run success numbers was noise; the record above documents that detour so it is not repeated.
